hero.title: We Help With the Journey Around Your Treatment
hero.subtitle: Supporting international patients before, during, and after their medical treatment in India.
hero.description: Medical treatment is the most important part of your journey, but there are many practical details around it. IBN Sina helps patients and their families coordinate every stage of the healthcare journey, making the process easier and more comfortable.

overview.title: Comprehensive Patient Support
overview.description: From your first enquiry to your return home, our dedicated patient coordinators provide personalized assistance to help you navigate every step of your medical journey in India.

beforeTreatment.title: Before Treatment
beforeTreatment.description: We help you prepare for your healthcare journey by coordinating the essential steps before you travel.

duringTreatment.title: During Your Stay
duringTreatment.description: Once you arrive in India, our team remains available to support you throughout your treatment.

afterTreatment.title: After Treatment
afterTreatment.description: Our support continues even after your treatment is completed, ensuring a smooth recovery and return home.

items.title: Dedicated Patient Coordinators
items.description: A single point of contact to guide you throughout your healthcare journey.

items.title: End-to-End Coordination
items.description: From medical records to hospital appointments and follow-up care.

items.title: Personalized Support
items.description: Every patient's journey is tailored according to their medical needs.

items.title: Peace of Mind
items.description: We simplify the practical aspects of medical travel so you can focus on your recovery.

goal.title: Our Goal
goal.description: Our goal is simple: to make the process around your treatment easier to manage.

cta.title: Let Us Support Your Healthcare Journey
cta.description: Whether you're planning treatment, traveling to India, or returning home after care, our team is here to help every step of the way.
